in_hebrew.name: Keane
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Keane הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Keane has its roots in the Greek language, where it was derived from the Greek word 'keanos', which means 'fighter'. Historically, the name was borne by several early Christian saints, including St. Keanus of Ireland and St. Kean of the Holy Land.
